paragraphs: He taught Rav about the properties of fish, as in [Moed Katan 11a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.11a.19-20).[^1]

notes.text: Rav introduces the advice by saying, “Adda the fisherman told me.” [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=240&lang=en) likewise describes Rav as transmitting in Adda’s name.
